summary: Directories this CLI creates for backup and feed output are 0700, matching the 0600 the files themselves already carry, because everything it writes is one person's schedule.
reason: backup and feed deliberately write 0600 files, then created their parent directory 0755, so the filenames and the directory listing stayed world-readable. gosec G301 flags it and the inconsistency was unintentional rather than a considered trade-off. A separate G202 on the legacy-database VACUUM INTO is a false positive kept narrow with an inline suppression: SQLite takes a string literal there, the path is process-derived, and single quotes are already doubled.
validated_outcome: gosec findings in hand-authored files went from 3 to 0; a fresh backup directory is created drwx------.
